basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old graphic designer based in Seattle. My passion lies in visual kei music and art, which is why you'll often find me hanging out on related subreddits. I love digital art and use Clip Studio for most of my projects. Outside of Reddit, I enjoy attending local music gigs and exploring new art styles. I'm in a long-term relationship and we often collaborate on creative projects. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, Pacific Time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design from an art school in San Francisco. I've been a self-taught digital artist since my teens, constantly learning through online tutorials and community feedback. My interest in visual kei expanded my horizon in art and music, giving me a unique aesthetic perspective.
